parsed.explanation: No explicit criminalisation exists on paper, but the record documents state-tolerated targeting: police/military raids on queer assembly spaces, collective detention of lesbians on 'sect' grounds, public shaming parades, and the 2023 detention of an LGBTI organiser amid rising restrictions. Trans women face harassment and sexual violence in police custody — a state-perpetrated tier-1/tier-2 exposure. Rape is used as conversion practice while rape enforcement is rare and police/military perpetrators are immune, so recourse is thin. Authorities still apply the 1954 vagrancy law; a repressive general-politics climate constrains advocacy. Visitor-specific border/facility data is absent, but extrapolating from documented state hostility, custody violence and impunity, the severity-if-outed profile is high. Weighting: organised/state-tolerated targeting (tier 2) plus custody sexual violence with no working remedy, tempered by no documented executions or presentation arrests and partly undated incidents.
